title: Choose the visual world for the Weekly Session
question: The roll assigned The Turndown Card. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Turndown Card
options.lineage: hotel turndown cards left on the pillow at night
options.thesis: The Weekly Session is turndown service for her week: someone prepared tomorrow while she was out.
options.viewport: Phone, full screen, no sidebar. A single cream card fills the frame with a blind-embossed pf. at top, WEEK 37 in small tracked caps, one italic line in the concierge's hand ("Good evening. Let's turn your week down."), and the five steps printed as a short list with hairline rules; the first step is the only filled mark and the card's one dark button reads Begin. Every step is a new card placed on the same pillow: same frame, new contents.
options.risk: Cream card plus italic serif is where this brand already lives; if the card is not physically convincing (weight, emboss, hairlines) it collapses into a generic cream wizard.

raised.raise: Every state is a printed mark: an empty square at rest, filled when chosen, struck through when spent; hairlines drawn at one device pixel, no rounded corners on marks.
Every priority shows the goal it pulls on, and every ritual the life lane it protects; the week card reads as balanced or leaning, never as a neutral list.
Rose is reserved by law for the one thing that matters now: the current step's mark, the day's one priority, the sale that closed the gap.
The generated week sits on one fixed seven-day graticule at the same scale every time; completing the session locks it still, like a triggered trace.
The card frame never moves; navigation swaps the card's contents, and the exit of one card is the entrance of the next.

options.label: The Class Schedule
options.lineage: the studio booking board she already uses every week
options.thesis: The session is Sunday's 7pm class; steps are the class sequence, and booking it is the commitment.
options.viewport: Phone, full screen. A schedule column for Sunday with one highlighted slot, Weekly Session · 20 min, and the five steps as a class sequence beneath it; Book is the primary action and each step then opens as its own slot card.
options.risk: It is the screen she already knows, which is also why most runs in this category land near it; it can read as a booking app rather than as her own studio.

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference Setting
options.lineage: wide-margin scholarly editions ruled by a ruling engine
options.thesis: The session as a keyed reference page: two short columns around a rail of keys, every state a printed mark.
materials: hairline rules at one device pixel
options.viewport: Phone: the rail goes outboard; a narrow text measure with keyed steps 1 to 5 down the margin, detents cut where the flow changes, and the current key filled in rose.
options.case: Fuses cleanly on clarity: keys, detents and printed-mark states carry a guided flow with no chrome. Loses on identification: she does not see herself in a scholarly apparatus.
options.risk: Reads as a document to study rather than a session to walk through.

options.label: Drawcord Cape
options.lineage: a silk cape with hidden drawcord channels
options.thesis: Five inputs lie flat; one pull of the cord gathers them into the shape of a week.
options.viewport: Phone: goals, revenue, rituals and calendar laid flat as stitched channels; a single cord handle at the bottom; pulling it gathers the plane into the week.
options.case: Holds identification: the material world of a woman whose friends dress well. Loses on clarity: five steps of honest data entry do not survive as a single pull.
options.risk: Black silk and gold conflict with the cream studio; translated to cream and rose it risks becoming decoration on a form.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.lineage: carbon rods and red cord held apart by opposing forces
options.thesis: Business and life as opposing tensions that hold the week rigid.
options.case: The two-lane idea is apt, but she does not identify with an engineering bench, and a force diagram hides the task.
options.kept: Every priority traces to the goal it pulls on; every ritual to the lane it protects.

options.label: CRT Arcade Pixel Glow
options.thesis: The week as a tile-grid stage under scanlines.
options.case: Loses both axes: wrong audience, and a guided session cannot live on a 240-line playfield.
options.kept: One colour reserved by law for the thing that matters now.

options.label: Oscilloscope Bench
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscopes on a signal bench
options.thesis: Her week as a triggered trace on a ten-division graticule.
options.case: Loses both axes: instrument culture is not hers, and knobs are the wrong controls for words.
options.kept: One fixed graticule for the week; completing the session locks the trace still.

options.label: PC-98 Sixteen-Colour Field
options.thesis: Fixed regions, a docked text window, dithered light.
options.case: Loses both axes: retro-computing is not her world and a bitmap face fights the brand's type.
options.kept: The frame never moves; each step swaps the card's contents, never the layout.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A five-step wizard with a progress bar, white cards and one dark primary button, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Step 1 of 5 with a progress bar on top, a card with a heading, three textareas and a Next button pinned to the bottom.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every onboarding wizard she has abandoned.
